text: dev-b: libs/shared-contracts is inlined at build time, so core-shell/reports only need a rebuild after your PLAT-104-1 merges. Also: CD detects changes per app dir, so I'll touch each app. Ping me when 104-1 is merged to main.

PLAT-104-1 merged (PR #1, main e168e4b). shared-contracts is in-repo & inlined at build, no registry release/dependency bump. CD only detects changes under apps/<app>/, so your app needs a real change in its own dir (I'm bumping version in package.json) to rebuild+deploy. Pull main first.
